description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build and improve AI talent agents for a recruiting technology platform that connects engineers with growing startups. As a founding engineer on a small team, you will own agent quality and reliability, from evaluation systems to production infrastructure.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build simulation harnesses that run agents against production code, schemas, and background jobs in local environments.

 - Create scenario evaluations and assertions that turn production failures into regression tests.

 - Compare prompt variants and agent runtimes on shared scenarios, measuring cost, cache hits, and latency.

 - Own agent observability, including traces, prompt versioning, rollouts, and service monitoring.

 - Develop platform infrastructure using TypeScript services, cloud deployments, background jobs, and PostgreSQL.

 - Speak with candidates and hiring teams to help shape agent capabilities.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 2 years of production software experience, including on-call or ownership of production issues.

 - Experience building or operating LLM evaluation or simulation harnesses with scenarios, assertions, and regression tests based on production failures.

 - Experience shipping LLM features to real users.

 - Strong TypeScript and Node.js skills; Python experience is a plus.

 - Experience with PostgreSQL, queues, background jobs, CI/CD, and cloud deployments, including GCP Cloud Run or a similar platform.

 - Experience with observability tools such as Langfuse or Datadog, prompt versioning, and rollout practices.

 - Agent runtime, load testing, or LLM latency and cost optimization experience is helpful, as is early-stage startup experience.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $130,000 to $170,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available, including OPT sponsorship for qualified candidates.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California.
